main_text.p: qui tum a Secretis erat, virum literis omnibus excultum. Et hæc contra Ignatium a Photio procurata; & ad summum perducta Synodus erit Oecumenica?. Qui conuenit? Lupus in Pastorem iniurius, in gregem intrusus, aliena indigne occupans, a viro multorum criminum, & depositocconsecratus, potestate, ac vi secularium, & tyrannide dominantium promotus Synodum Oecumenicam constituet? Hoc plane Latini non dicent, quod nec Græci etiam ipsi Ecclesiæ Romanæ infensi audent dicere. Quis præter ipsum Photium, & Photij mancipia promotionem Photij approbauit, idque in Photiana hac de qua agimus Synodo? Quis Ignatium vnquam inter Græcos vti criminum reum condemnatum fuisse, nisi execrandissimus quispiam pronunciauit? Hæc Synodus iustum condemnauit, & eum ipsum quem vniuersa Græcorum Ecclesia inter Sanctos relatum colit, & veneratur; & multorum criminum reum in eius locum substituit. Non erit ergo apud Græcos, quidquid sit apud Hæreticos, Oecumenica, cum Græci suas Oecumenicas Synodos colant, & observent, neque ab illis in aliquo deflectere profiteantur. page.notes: The Greek phrase after "quam" is printed in a small italic face and is hard to read; the transcription "συνοδικὸν λεγικόν" is a best reading and is not certain. The paragraph breaks within the page could not be decided with confidence, so the page is given as one paragraph continuing from the previous page. The "B" at the foot is a signature mark, not text. Show-through and fragments at the left and right edges were left out. The printed "dicitur" is kept as printed.
